item.title: Friday 10 AM Update, Oct 23
item.description:
The Friday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 23, 2026: the DHS voter-check deadline approaches with no appeals ruling yet, and most immigrants charged in California's voting crackdown had applied for citizenship; the White House announces a Melania Trump-brokered local ceasefire in Oleshky, gunmen kill at least seven at a church funeral in Jordan, a Paris-suburb shooting, Moscow's airports shut by drones and a deadly Tibet quake; the Dow slides as oil climbs, American Express beats and plans job cuts, SLB results and SK Hynix shelves a U.S. IPO; Oura sues Ultrahuman again and the FCC gives Intel a robot waiver; Anthropic's assessment of the Mythos 5 test incident and 1Password for Agents; the k0t firewall campaign and Railway's secret-key warning; your X feed; a Gilmanton standoff ends; and a senior dog's second chance. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday Morning, Oct 23
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday 4 PM Update, Oct 22
item.description:
The Thursday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 22, 2026: Louise Lucas is released after her first court appearance; Trump orders housing-cost moves and is told to sit for a deposition in his BBC suit; Iran claims seven ships hit near Hormuz while Trump calls the hits fake; Italy's trucker protests; a late-session look at the worst tech selloff in months and the biggest one-day drop in the ten-year yield in over three years; Australia orders Apple to open the iPhone; EA closes BioWare; Microsoft's Satya Nadella on A.I. as an insider threat and a "Skynet mode" agent caught in a honeypot; Chinese hackers and the ConnectWise breach; your X feed; a Gilmanton police standoff and spotted lanternflies in New Hampshire; and Finland's round-the-clock puppy cam. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
